title: Allyl ether of mansonone G as a potential anticancer agent for colorectal cancer.
authors: Chanvijit, Savinee; Phuagkhaopong, Suttinee; Mahalapbutr, Panupong; Klaewkla, Methus; Chavasiri, Warinthorn; Wonganan, Piyanuch
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然产物衍生物对结直肠癌的细胞毒性与凋亡机制，仅涉及小分子-激酶对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Mansonone G (MG), a 1,2-naphthoquinone isolated from the heartwood of Mansonia gagei Drumm, exhibited several pharmacological activities such as anti-bacterial, anti-estrogenic and anti-adipogenic effect. This study evaluated the cytotoxicity of MG and its derivatives as well as determined the mechanism(s) underlying the cytotoxic activity of the most potent MG derivative on two CRC cell lines, HCT-116 cells carrying p53 wild-type and HT-29 cells carrying p53 mutant. We found that MG and its derivatives could inhibit viability of HCT-116 and HT-29 cells in a concentration-dependent manner. Of all semi-synthetic derivatives of MG, allyl ether mansonone G (MG7) was the most potent cytotoxic agent toward cancer cells and less toxic to normal cells. MG7 could induce ROS generation which was associated with cytotoxicity and apoptosis in both HCT-116 and HT-29 cells. Western blot analysis revealed that MG7 downregulated the expression of Bcl-2 and Bcl-xL proteins in both CRC cell lines and upregulated the expression of BAK protein in HT-29 cells. Moreover, MG7 inhibited AKT signaling pathway in both CRC cell lines and modulated ERK1/2 signaling pathway by inhibiting ERK1/2 phosphorylation in HCT-116 cells and activating ERK1/2 phosphorylation in HT-29 cells. Molecular docking revealed that MG7 could bind to the ATP-binding pocket of AKT and ERK1 via hydrophobic interactions.
abstract_zh: Mansonone G (MG) 是一种从 Mansonia gagei Drumm 心材中分离得到的 1,2-萘醌，具有多种药理活性，如抗菌、抗雌激素和抗脂肪生成作用。本研究评估了 MG 及其衍生物的细胞毒性，并确定了最具潜力的 MG 衍生物在两种结直肠癌细胞系（携带 p53 野生型的 HCT-116 细胞和携带 p53 突变型的 HT-29 细胞）中发挥细胞毒性活性的机制。我们发现 MG 及其衍生物能以浓度依赖性方式抑制 HCT-116 和 HT-29 细胞的活力。在所有 MG 半合成衍生物中，烯丙基醚 mansonone G (MG7) 对癌细胞最具细胞毒性，且对正常细胞毒性较低。MG7 能诱导 ROS 生成，这与 HCT-116 和 HT-29 细胞中的细胞毒性和凋亡相关。Western blot 分析显示，MG7 在两种结直肠癌细胞系中下调了 Bcl-2 和 Bcl-xL 蛋白的表达，并在 HT-29 细胞中上调了 BAK 蛋白的表达。此外，MG7 抑制了两种结直肠癌细胞系中的 AKT 信号通路，并通过抑制 HCT-116 细胞中的 ERK1/2 磷酸化和激活 HT-29 细胞中的 ERK1/2 磷酸化来调节 ERK1/2 信号通路。分子对接显示，MG7 可通过疏水相互作用结合到 AKT 和 ERK1 的 ATP 结合口袋。
